title: Duna, Tisza, Balaton, Alföld, Kékes: Hungary on the Map

sections.title: Rivers, a lake, a plain and a mountain
sections.content: You know *Magyarország* and *Budapest* from A1 and *Duna* from Unit 7. Four more names let you talk about Hungary: the *Tisza*, the other big river, which crosses the *Alföld* (the Great Plain); the *Balaton*, the biggest lake in the country; and the *Kékes*, the highest mountain in Hungary. You know *keresztül* with *-n* from Unit 5 and the superlative *leg-…-bb* from Unit 16, and both appear here.

items.spanish: A Tisza az Alföldön keresztül folyik.
items.english: The Tisza flows across the Great Plain.

items.spanish: A Balaton a legnagyobb tó Magyarországon.
items.english: Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary.

items.spanish: A Kékes a legmagasabb hegy Magyarországon.
items.english: Kékes is the highest mountain in Hungary.

sections.content: River and lake names take *a*: *a Duna*, *a Tisza*, *a Balaton*, but *az Alföld* before a vowel. The verb of a *folyó* is *folyik* ("flows").
